key_points: FedEx Dataworks partners with Stripe to expand funding and payment options for SMBs
FedEx will support over 50 new payment methods via the Stripe integration
Positive coverage of FedEx's fleet electrification drives a reversal after recent losses
JP Morgan keeps an Overweight rating on FDX, though the price target remains low
Collectively, the news adds modest bullish momentum for the stock in the near term
